summary: Usage export obscures route identifiers after org-scoped RBAC change
description:
Issue summary:
Customer reports that CSV exports from Console > Usage show route and route-id columns with masked or redacted values (e.g. 'REDACTED-ROUTE') after an org-scoped RBAC rollout. This started immediately after Clipnote changed their org-level RBAC setting to hide route names for non-admins. Impact: finance and engineering cannot reconcile usage records to internal routing labels; downstream billing attribution and cost allocation are blocked.

Impact:
- Clipnote cannot attribute ~2 weeks of daily exports to product teams (estimated $45k monthly bill allocation impact).
- Blocking finance reconciliation for month-end close.

Environment:
- Customer org: Clipnote Inc. (enterprise)
- Region: prod-us-east
- Console export path: Console > Organization > Usage > Export CSV (last 30 days)

Observed behavior:
- Exported CSV includes columns 'route_name' and 'route_id' but values are 'REDACTED-ROUTE' (same token repeated) for many rows.
- The Console UI still shows full route names to the reporting admin, but the exported file contains masked values.

Expected behavior:
- Admin-triggered exports should include raw route identifiers for reconciliation, or at minimum include an additional column with raw IDs when the exporter has sufficient permissions.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Org admin flips 'hide route names from non-admins' flag in Org Settings (RBAC rollout).
2) Admin navigates to Console > Usage > Export CSV and requests last 30 days.
3) Download CSV and inspect 'route_name' and 'route_id' columns.
4) Observe 'REDACTED-ROUTE' tokens instead of the expected identifiers.
logs_and_artifacts:
- Customer-provided CSV sample: usage_export_obscured_sample.csv (attached).
- Console export job id: export_job_20260310_Clipnote_72b4
- API request trace: GET /orgs/clipnote/usage/export job initiated by api-key: clipnote-admin-xx
- Relevant console audit: org_setting_change RBAC: hide-route-names = true @ 2026-03-09T22:05:12Z
investigation_notes:
- Initial hypothesis: masking logic (org-level RBAC) is being applied at export job time.
- Checked export worker code path: background export uses the same rendering helpers as UI, and the helper respects the 'hide_route_names' org flag. The export worker runs as a background job with system identity but reads org-level display helpers which currently apply masking unconditionally.
- Reproduced in staging: toggled org flag -> export as admin -> export file contains masked values.
- Found recent change in PR #5821 (related_github_pr) where render_route_for_display() was moved into api-gateway middleware and now consults org.preferences.show_route_names. This was intended to affect UI only but the export job calls the same renderer.
- Quick workaround available: export via admin API with query param include_raw=true (private flag) or run SQL export from billing service if customer has database access.
resolution_notes:
- Engineering created hotfix PR to decouple export worker from UI renderer: introduce export_include_raw_routes flag and bypass display masking for system exports. Hotfix PR merged and deployed to prod-us-east 2026-03-12 (release 2026.03.12-hotfix-usage-export).
- Customer asked to re-download export after deploy. Clipnote confirmed new export contained raw route identifiers and reconciliation succeeded for a sample day.
- Longer-term follow-up: add audit log for export options and add explicit export permission 'exports.raw_routes'. Create a migration plan to surface raw-route column only to permitted roles. See linked internal task INT-4452 for rollout plan.
